description: Unique identifier created for each Tamil Nadu SEZ in this dataset.
Country where the SEZ is located. All rows are India.
Indian state where the SEZ is located. All rows are Tamil Nadu.
District name as reported or implied in the official SEZ India operational SEZ list.
Cleaned/current district name used for analysis. This may differ from district_official where district boundaries or names have changed.
Name of the SEZ developer, authority, or zone as listed in the official SEZ India source.
Administrative location description from the official SEZ list, usually including village, taluk, city, or industrial park.
Sector or activity type of the SEZ, such as IT/ITES, engineering, electronics, footwear, FTWZ, or multi-sector.
Broad sector category created for easier summary tables and figures.
Operational status of the SEZ. All included rows are operational SEZs.
Approximate latitude of the SEZ point location in decimal degrees.
Approximate longitude of the SEZ point location in decimal degrees.
Coordinate reference system for latitude and longitude. Coordinates use WGS84 / EPSG:4326.
Level of precision for the manually assigned coordinates, such as industrial-area approximation, town/cluster approximation, or village/area approximation.

Qualitative reliability rating for the manually assigned coordinates. Higher means the point is closer to a known SEZ, industrial park, or specific business location; medium means the point is based on a town or cluster; medium_low means the point is based on a broader village or area approximation.
Source used to assign latitude and longitude. Coordinates were manually assigned using public map searches and official location text.
Indicator for whether official GIS boundaries or polygons were available. In this dataset, official SEZ boundaries were not available.
Explanation that coordinates are approximate point locations and should not be interpreted as official SEZ boundaries.
Identifier linking the row to the source audit file, sources.csv.
Description of the dataset scope. This dataset covers operational SEZs in Tamil Nadu from the official SEZ India list.
Indicator equal to 1 if the observation has non-missing latitude and longitude and can be used in spatial analysis; 0 otherwise.
Additional notes about the SEZ, including name changes, district changes, or source-specific limitations.
Raw notification date text from the SEZ India notified SEZ list. Some rows contain multiple dates because of amendments, additions, or denotifications.
Official SEZ notification date from the SEZ India notified SEZ list, stored in YYYY-MM-DD format where verified.
Year extracted from notification_date. Used as a proxy for SEZ establishment year in the dynamic extension.
Source used to verify the notification date, usually the official SEZ India notified SEZ list.
Notes on notification-date matching, including whether multiple dates were listed or whether the date was not yet verified.
